text:
Five small sausage-like patties or cookie bites and about 10 raspberries.

Each bite is about 3.5 cm in diameter and roughly 10 g, so the five weigh about 50 g. If they are sausage, that is around 150 kcal; if they are cookie-like, closer to 200 kcal. They look like mini muffin tops or cookies. At about 4 kcal/g, 50 g gives roughly 200 kcal.

The raspberries weigh about 4 g each, so 10–12 berries come to about 45 g and 25 kcal.

Total: about 95 g and 225 kcal.
